title: Tools redesign: a sky and a viewfinder
lede: Direction 2: each tool gets its own look. Golden Hour becomes a live sky that tracks the sun at the chosen venue; Timelapse becomes a camera viewfinder. Both use the brand's self-hosted Gotham. Same logic, routes and tests as the audit pass.

changes.h: Golden Hour looked like any web form
changes.was: Grey cards, a flat bar timeline and a yellow banner; theme toggle in the header.
changes.now: The whole page is the sky: night, blue, gold or day from the sun's real altitude at the venue, crossfading as it changes. The timeline is now the sun's actual path with the golden and blue altitude bands drawn through it, and a live sun marker.

changes.was: “Golden hour now · 19m left” in a pill.
changes.now: A hero that reads from across a room: GOLDEN HOUR / 36 min left · until 7:11 PM, or “in 2h 56m · starts 6:15 PM”, with “tomorrow” when it is.

changes.h: Timelapse's result was just another card
changes.was: Result card, stats grid and menu card stacked under a long form.
changes.now: A viewfinder: focus brackets, REC dot (grey when a plan is refused), HUD for mode, body, frames, speed-up and card space. On phones it sticks to the top while you change settings.
A time funnel draws it to scale: the real-time roll with frame ticks, narrowing to the clip.

changes.was: System font, same grey chrome on every page.
changes.now: Gotham (already self-hosted by the app; CSP now allows font-src 'self'). Each tool has its own palette; the hub previews them.

notes: Golden Hour and Timelapse are now single-appearance by design: the sky picks Golden Hour's palette, and Timelapse is always dark like a camera LCD. The Auto/Light/Dark toggle is gone from both.
